title: Robinsons Offices welcomes Transcom to Bridgetowne, strengthening partnership and office market momentum

blocks.text: Robinsons Offices, the office development and leasing arm of Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC), has leased 2,490 square meters at Giga Tower in Bridgetowne, Quezon City, to Transcom Worldwide (Philippines), Inc., further strengthening its collaboration with the leading global BPO company. Located on the building’s 12th floor, the newly opened facility is Transcom’s very first in Quezon City and its seventh in the Philippines. Transcom currently operates from Robinsons Cybergate Delta in Davao City, making Giga Tower its second facility with Robinsons Offices.
